title: Volleyball: NU makes quick work of Arellano for third straight win
summary: National University cruised to a third straight win in the 2026 Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup on Saturday, overpowering Arellano University in straight sets at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum.
